newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed on election day, seen quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed on election day, seen quiet.

text.p: UK shares opened mixed as polling began on Thursday and dealers predicted a quiet session as investors exercised caution despite forecasts of a decisive outcome to the poll.
The leading FTSE 100 index had crept 5.9 points higher to 4,441.9 by 0740 GMT. Gainers were in a three-to-one majority.
"The market will find it very difficult to make much progress now the election is upon us," said one trader. "Despite the fact that Wall Street was up...it will be a very dull day."
The index finished 2.8 points higher on Wednesday at 4,436.0 after earlier setting a record intraday high of 4,466.5.
